lithuania_average_gross_wage.note: Lithuania's average gross monthly wage, used as the reference figure for EU Blue Card salary thresholds (1.2x for shortage/high-value-added occupations, 1.5x for other occupations). Statistics Lithuania (stat.gov.lt) republishes this figure quarterly; the 2023 base figure here was reported via the European Commission's EU Immigration Portal, not independently re-verified against stat.gov.lt directly in this pass. Treat as a snapshot pending a tier-1 refresh.

sources.title: European Commission EU Immigration Portal -- Lithuania EU Blue Card: salary thresholds pegged to average gross wage (1.2x shortage occupations, 1.5x other occupations)
